plugins.name: simple-writing
plugins.description: Write plain text that a reader understands on one read, in the language of the user. It is a multilingual version of SimpleEnglish by AminBlg. It keeps the discipline of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one word one meaning, active voice, condition before command, terms defined at first use.
